meta.note: The city past the play box from the City of Seattle 2015 roof outlines (apex elevation) and the USGS 3DEP DEM. boxes: [x, z, w, d, h, rot, cls, g], game units, rot = rotation.y (w along local X). cls 0 = the low fabric of a 16 u cell within 900 m of the box edge as one mass (area-weighted height, shrunk to the built area); cls 1 = a building of 35 m or more (its own oriented rectangle) out to 47.545-47.670 N / -122.43..-122.27 (First Hill, Capitol Hill, Queen Anne, SoDo). Outside about 1 km only outlines whose roof apex is above 350 ft were fetched, so far LOW buildings are not in the file (fill those with the land colour). g = ground under the box (game units above the waterfront; First Hill and Capitol Hill reach 18-30 u, Queen Anne 25-28 u): the game ground is flat, lift the backdrop by g (or a share of it) to suggest the hills, or ignore it. named: index into boxes. water: Elliott Bay / Puget Sound over the surround box (piers and islands are holes) and the lakes (Lake Union, Portage Bay, Lake Washington edge) as {name, polygon, holes}. masts: Queen Anne's broadcast towers. cranes: Port of Seattle container cranes (about 80 m to the boom hinge top; boomUp = a raised boom, about 110 m). horizon: far features by bearing (deg clockwise from north) and distance from the box centre.

horizon.name: Mount Rainier
horizon.note: the 4,392 m glaciated stratovolcano, white snowfields and dark rock ridges; it fills the south-south-east horizon above SoDo and the Duwamish on a clear day

horizon.name: The Brothers (Olympics)
horizon.note: twin-peaked summit of the Olympic Mountains across Puget Sound; the jagged snow-streaked Olympic range runs along the whole western horizon behind Bainbridge Island

horizon.name: Mount Constance (Olympics)
horizon.note: the highest peak seen from Seattle in the eastern Olympics

horizon.name: Mount Baker
horizon.note: far to the north-north-east, a white cone low on the horizon

horizon.name: Bainbridge Island
horizon.note: low wooded island 10 km west across the Sound (the ferries' destination)

horizon.name: Alki Point / West Seattle
horizon.note: the wooded bluff of West Seattle across Elliott Bay to the south-west

horizon.name: Magnolia bluff
horizon.note: wooded bluff closing Elliott Bay to the north-west
